data.name: Kity Release
data.body:
# How to use
1. Download and launch kitty.
2. Find an available PS5 console.
3. Connect to the console.
4. Launch GTA 6.
5. Stream the gameplay directly to your PC.

# Requirements:

* Windows PC
* Stable internet connection
* Controller (recommended)

**How it works:** The game runs on a real PS5, while KittyPS5 streams the video to your PC and sends your controls back to the console.

README.md.text:
# GTA6-KytyPS5-GTA-6 ### A KytyPS5 fork built around one goal: a comfortable Grand Theft Auto VI experience on PC.

--- > [!NOTE] > This project is **not affiliated with** Sony Interactive Entertainment, Rockstar Games or > Take-Two Interactive. It contains **no games, firmware, keys or copyrighted files** and does not > help you obtain them. You must use your own legally dumped copy of the game.
## 💻 System requirements | | Minimum | Recommended | |---|---|---| | **OS** | Windows 10 64-bit (22H2) | Windows 11 64-bit | | **CPU** | 6 cores, AVX2 | 8+ cores, high single-thread performance | | **GPU** | Vulkan 1.3 capable, 8 GB VRAM | 12 GB+ VRAM, recent NVIDIA / AMD | | **RAM** | 16 GB | 32 GB | | **Storage** | SSD, 300 GB free | NVMe SSD, 300 GB free | | **Drivers** | Latest GPU driver | Latest GPU driver | > [!TIP] > An SSD matters a lot: the game streams large amounts of data, and shader cache files are written > continuously during the first hours of play. ## Quick start 1. **Download** the latest `KytyPS5-GTA-6-vX.Y.Z-win64.zip` from [Releases](../../releases/latest). 2. **Extract** it to a folder with a short path and no special characters, for example `C:\Emulators\KytyPS5-GTA-6`. 3. **Update your GPU driver** (Vulkan 1.3 is required). 4. **Run** `kyty.exe`. The first launch is slower because shaders are compiled and cached. Later launches are faster and noticeably smoother. ## Configuration Configuration lives in `config/` next to the executable. ```text KytyPS5-GTA-6/ ├── KytyPS5-GTA-6.exe ├── config/ │ ├── global.toml # default settings │ └── games/ │ └── gta6.toml # per-game overrides ├── cache/ │ └── shaders/ # persistent shader cache ├── logs/ └── docs/ ``` Example `config/games/gta6.toml` : ```toml [graphics] preset = "balanced" resolution_scale = 1.0 upscaler = "off" # off | fsr frame_limit = 60 # 0 = unlimited vsync = false [shaders] async_compile = true cache_enabled = true [audio] latency_ms = 80 [input] profile = "xinput" # xinput | dualsense deadzone = 0.12 [debug] overlay = true log_level = "info" # error | warn | info | debug ``` ## 🎮 Controls | Action | Keyboard | Controller | |---|---|---| | Toggle overlay | `F1` | `Back + Y` | | Screenshot | `F12` | `Back + X` | | Pause emulation | `F5` | `Back + Start` | | Toggle fullscreen | `Alt + Enter` | — | | Reload shader cache | `Ctrl + R` | — | | Quit | `Alt + F4` | `Back + Start (hold)` | ## Troubleshooting
The game does not start / crashes immediately - Make sure your GPU driver is up to date and supports Vulkan 1.3. - Check that the game folder is complete and uses a supported layout. - Delete the `cache/` folder and try again. - Run with `log_level = "debug"` and attach `logs/latest.log` to an issue.
Heavy stuttering - The first hours are the slowest: the shader cache is still being built. - Enable `async_compile` and make sure the cache is on an SSD. - Close overlays from other software (recording, RGB, monitoring tools). - Try the **Performance** preset.
Black screen or missing graphics - Switch the Vulkan device in settings if you have several GPUs. - Disable third-party Vulkan layers (some overlays inject them). - Attach a log and your GPU model to an issue.
No sound or crackling audio - Increase `latency_ms` in the audio section (try 120). - Make sure the default Windows audio device is not in exclusive mode for another app.
Controller is not detected - Reconnect the controller before starting the emulator. - For DualSense, use USB or a supported Bluetooth connection and select the `dualsense` profile.
Will other PS5 games work? Possibly, since the fork builds on the same core, but only GTA 6 is actively tested.
Is there a Linux or macOS build? Windows is the primary target. Linux is experimental, macOS is not supported yet.
## Architecture ```mermaid flowchart LR G[Guest game code] --> CPU[CPU / x86-64 execution layer] CPU --> SYS[Kernel & syscall emulation] CPU --> GFX[GPU command processor] GFX --> SH[Shader translator + cache] SH --> VK[Vulkan renderer] SYS --> AUD[Audio backend] SYS --> INP[Input: XInput / DualSense] VK --> OVL[Overlay & frame pacing] ``` | Module | Responsibility | |---|---| | `core/` | Guest memory, CPU execution, syscalls | | `gpu/` | GPU command stream, shader translation, shader cache | | `render/` | Vulkan backend, upscaling, frame pacing | | `audio/` | Audio output and latency handling | | `input/` | Keyboard, XInput, DualSense | | `launcher/` | Library, presets, bug reporter | ## Roadmap - [x] Fork setup and CI builds - [x] GTA 6 game profile and presets - [x] Persistent shader cache - [x] Performance overlay - [ ] Stable boot to main menu on all tested GPUs - [ ] Stable in-game performance on mid-range hardware - [ ] Remove remaining graphical artefacts - [ ] Audio sync in cutscenes - [ ] Controller polish (DualSense features) - [ ] Linux parity - [ ] Send generic fixes upstream See the [issue tracker](../../issues) and [project board](../../projects) for details. ## Contributing Contributions are welcome. 1. Fork the repository and create a branch: `git checkout -b feature/my-change` 2. Keep generic emulator fixes in **separate commits** from GTA 6 specific changes. 3. Add or update tests where it makes sense. 4. Open a pull request describing **what** changed and **how you tested it**. Please read [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) and follow the [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md). For larger changes, open an issue first. ## Reporting issues Use the issue templates and include: - build version or commit hash, - game version, - CPU, GPU and driver version, - OS version, - your settings (`config/`), - `logs/latest.log`, - steps to reproduce, and a screenshot or short video if relevant. The launcher's **Create bug report** button collects most of this automatically. > [!IMPORTANT] > Do not post links to game files, keys or firmware in issues or discussions. Such posts will be deleted. ## Credits - **[InoriRus](https://github.com/InoriRus/Kyty)** — the original Kyty emulator - **[KytyPS5 contributors](https://github.com/KytyPS5/KytyPS5)** — the PS5 emulator this fork builds on - Everyone who tests builds and files detailed reports - [FFmpeg](https://ffmpeg.org/), [Vulkan](https://www.vulkan.org/), [Qt](https://www.qt.io/) and other open-source projects used by this fork --- **If this project helps you, consider giving it a ⭐**
